content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? There are plenty of options on the App Store that are ad-free and have no in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a good family subscription option, but it's not the only one. If you already subscribe to Netflix, you're actually already paying for access to a large library of iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription includes a massive iPhone and iPad game library

Now every Netflix subscription plan includes a huge mobile and TV game library.

This even includes the cheapest "Standard with ads" plan, which costs just $8.99 per month.

No matter which Netflix tier you've chosen, you already have access to mobile and TV games, with no ads, in-app purchases, or extra fees.

As for TV games, Netflix offers a dedicated iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app turns your phone or tablet into a game controller for playing games on supported Netflix smart TV apps. If you want to enhance your mobile gaming experience, a dedicated iPhone controller would be a great choice.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app designed specifically for kids called Netflix Playground, offering a variety of mini-games. There are also Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

In addition to these games, Netflix has a library of over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store, then sign in with your Netflix email and password to play.
